source_findings.asset-installation: AssetSegmentEvent extends ActualEvent. Asset and Segment are each structurally optional. The publisher’s Scenario 11 requires the asset, location and event time for that use case. Do not generalize the scenario’s required content to every core-schema instance.
source_findings.measurement-location: MeasurementLocation can identify a physical or virtual position on an asset or segment; it can identify a collection source address and transducer orientation. MeasurementSource is a collector or monitoring system. The three roles can differ.
source_findings.model-variant: ModelVariant uses parent and child models to represent a hierarchy of configurable variants. ModelRevision is a separate schema type. AssetModelEvent records past associations; current Model is a direct Asset link.
source_findings.work: WorkOrder collects requests and steps. Request, calendared work, active work and completed work are distinct representations. CompletedWork identifies actual work and can record used or removed resources.
source_findings.causality: ActualEvent may be substantiated by Measurement, optionally with ByAgent. ProposedEvent and HypotheticalEvent separately represent an explanatory hypothesis and a possible failure mode represented in an engineering study.
source_findings.reliability: RemainingLifeAssessment carries Estimate, Error and Confidence. LifecycleStatusHistory identifies the entity, required status type and optional status start date.
